value.text: Series of eleven sheets, RCIN 912376 to 912386

claims.statement: RCT: a series of eleven drawings of a deluge, RCIN 912376 to 912386; most in black chalk only, RCIN 912380 finished with pen and wash.

sources.cite: Royal Collection Trust, collection online, RCIN 912380, A deluge, c.1517 to 1518. Read through search engine excerpts in this session; the page itself was not fetched in this session.

claims.statement: RCT dates the series c.1517 to 1518 and thinks it most probable that they were made in France at the court of Francis I. Stylistic dating.
